question: Voice change during puberty occurs due to _______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** the development of larynx.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Puberty **is a phase of **physical and sexual development** in which the body undergoes various changes due to **hormonal changes.**
 
• During puberty, the** larynx,** which is also known as the **voice box,** grows** larger **in both males and females.
 
• The growth of the larynx causes the vocal cords to** lengthen and thicken**, resulting in a** deeper** and more **resonant voice.**
 
• The process of voice change during puberty is more prominent in** males** than in females.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cigarette smoking** is **harmful **to the lungs and can cause various respiratory diseases such as** bronchitis and lung cancer.**
 
• **Lung development** is a gradual process that starts **before birth** and continues throughout **childhood and adolescence.**
 
• **Muscular development** is also a gradual process that occurs throughout** childhood and adolescence.**
 
• Puberty usually starts in **girls** between the ages of** 8 and 13, **and in** boys** between the ages of **9 and 14**.
 
 
• Puberty is characterized by the development of **breasts** and the onset of **menstruation in girls** and larger testicles, deeper voice, and more muscular physique in **boys.**
